paper.title_en: Hawking radiation as a flux of Noether charge
paper.abstract_en: We present a geometric framework linking classical spacetime geometry to black hole thermodynamics beyond the stationary regime. By evaluating the Komar conserved current on an arbitrary timelike worldtube, with the off-boundary extension fixed by a Gaussian normal foliation, we obtain a local surface density <math display="inline"><msub><mi>κ</mi><mtext>Noether</mtext></msub></math> that requires no Killing vector, no spatial symmetry, and no slow-evolution assumption. It reduces to the Killing surface gravity for stationary non-degenerate horizons, and, applied to a uniformly accelerating worldtube, recovers the Unruh temperature. Adapting the Parikh-Wilczek tunneling method to horizons lacking radial and temporal symmetry, we show the local tunneling temperature is <math display="inline"><mi>T</mi><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>κ</mi><mtext>Noether</mtext></msub><mo>/</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi></math> at leading semiclassical order. For a black hole that is genuinely evolving, the single stationary notion of surface gravity separates, at first order in the evaporation rate, into a family of inequivalent quantities; at the event horizon, two of these carry distinct roles: <math display="inline"><msub><mi>κ</mi><mtext>Noether</mtext></msub></math> governs the local tracking kinematics and the proper temperature at the horizon, while the optical peeling rate <math display="inline"><msub><mi>κ</mi><mtext>peeling</mtext></msub></math> governs the asymptotic Bogoliubov spectrum. Evaluated on the exact Vaidya solution, this yields a closed-form surface gravity for the event horizon and an exact gap equation valid for arbitrary evaporation profiles. The separation has a definite causal character: the tracking rate is fixed by the instantaneous geometry, whereas the peeling rate is a functional of the horizon’s entire future, so local dynamics couples only to the former. Supplying the heat flux independently of the surface gravity, which the Vaidya geometry permits, shows further that the quasilocal first law on the apparent horizon is balanced not by the tracking rate but by the Kodama-Hayward value, with which it coincides only when the horizon’s acceleration vanishes. Four surface gravities on three surfaces therefore answer four distinct questions. These results give a local interpretation of the dynamical Komar charge, identifying the thermal emission of an evolving horizon with a flux of gravitational Noether charge.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提出了一种将经典时空几何与黑洞热力学联系起来的新几何框架，扩展了非平稳状态下的霍金辐射描述，并给出多种表面重力的区分，具有理论深度和新颖性。
decision.title_zh: 霍金辐射作为诺特荷的通量
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一个几何框架，将经典时空几何与超出平稳状态的黑洞热力学联系起来。通过在任意类时世界管上评估Komar守恒流，并用高斯正态叶状结构固定边界外延拓，我们得到了一个局部表面密度κ_Noether，它不需要Killing矢量、空间对称性或慢演化假设。对于平稳非退化视界，它简化为Killing表面重力，并且应用于均匀加速世界管时，恢复Unruh温度。将Parikh-Wilczek隧穿方法适应于缺乏径向和时间对称性的视界，我们展示了在领先半经典阶，局部隧穿温度为T = κ_Noether/(2π)。对于一个真正演化的黑洞，在蒸发速率的一阶，单一的平稳表面重力概念分裂为一族不等价的量；在事件视界，其中两个承载不同的角色：κ_Noether控制局部追踪运动学和在视界处的适当温度，而光学剥离速率κ_peeling控制渐近Bogoliubov谱。在精确的Vaidya解上评估，这产生了事件视界的闭式表面重力和适用于任意蒸发谱的精确间隙方程。这种分离具有明确的因果特征：追踪速率由瞬时几何固定，而剥离速率是视界整个未来的泛函，因此局部动力学仅与前者耦合。独立于表面重力提供热通量（Vaidya几何允许），进一步表明在表观视界上的准局部第一定律不是由追踪速率平衡，而是由Kodama-Hayward值平衡，只有当视界加速度为零时才与之重合。三个表面上的四个表面重力因此回答了四个不同的问题。这些结果给出了动力学Komar荷的局部解释，将演化视界的热发射识别为引力诺特荷的通量。
